name: 2-6-park-ave

building.title: 2-6 Park Ave (529), University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 529's outer ring from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; it chooses the crop box and the building's own points (frame.near_outline, measure and topview). The site replaces block 529 by its id.

origin.note: the campus origin, as in campus.json; the landmark's local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, with grid north

door.note: provisional, to be set at step 7

aerial.licence: Auckland Central 0.06 m Urban Aerial Photos (2023): sourced from LINZ and licensed by Auckland Council for re-use under CC BY 4.0

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) more than min_above m above the ground and within near_outline m of building.outline
frame.thresholds_note: min_above 3 m over the provisional ground (68.86 m); the centre from the same points (tower_above), which lie within 1.5 m of the campus map ring. The walls' axis runs along the block's long east face (bearing 198 deg), so z faces east-south-east, to Park Avenue

ground_note: 68.86 m: the median LiDAR ground (class 2) in the first crop, 25 m round the outline (p5 68.14, p95 71.35); provisional, to be the LiDAR's ground at the door (step 7)

light.note: provisional, as 501's; to be set from the photograph
